mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.25% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.25% are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When annualized inflation (computed from CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.0%, it signals a potential for central bank tightening, which increases equity discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in CPIAUCSL inflation > 2.0% periods are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: The co-occurrence of a labor market tightness (UNRATE < 5.0%) and strong economic growth (GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.0%) signals a robust economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction condition (UNRATE<5.0% AND GDPC1 growth>2.0%) occurs in >40% of samples but 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (defined by UNRATE < 5.0% and CPIAUCSL annualized inflation > 2.5%), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) signals an imminent tightening, which increases equity discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle periods, FEDFUNDS > 0.5% does not produce significantly negative 20-day returns (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) signals a weakening economy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in INDPRO<100.0 periods are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Positive annualized growth in real GDP (GDPC1) signals a strengthening economy, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in positive GDPC1 growth periods are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market slackness (UNRATE > 5.5%) signals an economy with excess capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in UNRATE>5.5% periods are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: The co-occurrence of weak industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) and low housing starts (HOUST < 1000.0) signals a broad economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction condition (INDPRO<100.0 AND HOUST<1000.0) occurs in >40% of samples but 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03.
